scope_notes: Tipstrr public stats are at (tipster × month) grain — per-bet selection / market detail is paywalled. Their headline ROI here covers ALL football bet types (1X2, OU, AH, BTTS, …); ours covers 1X2 + OU 2.5 only. Window-fit: only month-buckets whose entire span falls inside [start, end) are counted (partial months dropped). Stake normalised to 10 EUR/bet for parity.
